children: Gold rises in early Asian trade on a possible technical correction, after front-month gold futures settled lower overnight. Traders are waiting for Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh's scheduled speech on Friday, says Kudo.com's Konstantinos Chrysikos in a note. The probability of an October rate increase priced in the futures markets jumped to around 50% after the latest U.S. CPI data showed a firmer-than-expected reading for underlying inflation, before easing to less than 40% later Wednesday, according to CME Group. Higher rates typically diminish the allure of the non-interest-bearing precious metal. Spot gold is up 0.8% at $4,139.23 an ounce.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
